name: Chain Gun
doc: Chain Gun (GIM47N's attack): the root and the master - the muzzle flashes, the smoke, the twelve shots (hits on the target with their sparks, misses on the ground with their dust), the sound; the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag190_chain_gun.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools and packet arenas in the module).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Master
parts.doc: The muzzle flashes, the smoke, the twelve shots (hits on the target with their sparks, misses on the ground with their dust), the sound; the damage

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The damage at this tick of the master

params.label: Smoke
params.doc: The sprite sequence smoke (a flipbook of 16 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Flash
params.doc: The sprite sequence flash (a flipbook of 16 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Sparks
params.doc: The sprite sequence sparks (a flipbook of 15 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Muzzle model
params.doc: The prim model muzzle (a mesh of 25 vertices, 24 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Impact model
params.doc: The prim model impact (a mesh of 24 vertices, 16 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Spark model
params.doc: The prim model spark (a mesh of 24 vertices, 16 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Texture file
params.doc: The texture file its loader reads from the magic folder (a name of at most 31 letters)

params.label: Camera track
params.doc: The camera track its setup plays (any length: its offsets are its own)
